description:
Finds the ticker when the holder gives a name, part of a ticker or an ISIN
        (for example 'Vanguard total world' gives VT), with the exchange it
        trades on. Useful before a measurement whenever a ticker is not
        certain. Listings nobody here has checked are marked unchecked.

base.description: Currency every figure is expressed in (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD…). Default USD.
base.title: Base

query.description: A fund or company name, a ticker, or an ISIN.
query.title: Query

name: search_symbols

experimental.description: True for listings nobody here has checked.

symbol.description: Ticker as the exchange lists it; pass this to the measuring tools.

title: Find a ticker by name
